object.attr: analysis: a lenient reader also takes exponents, 'inf' and 'nan', and NaN compares false with everything, so a filter drops it unseen (CF-C19, review Q23, Q43). USAGE says only "parseable float".
object.description: If an object's non-blank value for a real attribute isn't an optional minus sign, one or more ASCII digits, and optionally a point and one or more ASCII digits, Mellon shall report ATTR_BAD_REAL.
